name: ADAPt
description: Converts all of your bonus attack damage into ability power, and additionally increases your ability power.

name: Adamant
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy grants bonus armor and magic resistance, stacking several times.

name: Blunt Force
description: Increases your attack damage.

name: Buff Buddies
description: Permanently gain the Crest of Cinders and Crest of Insight. Your basic attacks slow and burn enemies, and you gain ability haste plus mana/energy regeneration.

name: Deft
description: Grants bonus attack speed.

name: Dive Bomber
description: On death, you explode, dealing true damage to nearby enemies based on their maximum health.

name: Don't Blink
description: Deal increased damage scaling with how much faster your movement speed is than the target.

name: Erosion
description: Damaging an enemy briefly reduces their armor and magic resistance, stacking several times.

name: Escape Plan
description: When your health drops low, gain a large shield, bonus movement speed, and reduced size. These effects decay over time. (Has a cooldown)

name: First-Aid Kit
description: Increases your heal and shield power.

name: Flashbang
description: Using Flash creates an explosion that deals magic damage and slows nearby enemies. Your Flash also resets on death.

name: Frost Wraith
description: Periodically releases a frost pulse around you, rooting nearby enemies for a short duration.

name: Goredrink
description: Grants omnivamp (healing from all damage dealt).

name: Guilty Pleasure
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion heals you.

name: Hat on a Hat
description: Gain ability power and bonus magic resistance for each hat or headwear item in your inventory.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage based on the target’s maximum health.

name: Homeguard
description: Gain greatly increased movement speed, lost for a few seconds after taking damage from champions.

name: Ice Cold
description: Your slows reduce enemy movement speed by an additional amount.

name: Infernal Soul
description: Grants the Infernal Dragon Soul, dealing bonus area damage when you attack enemies. (Or a different Soul if already owned)

name: Leg Day
description: Grants bonus movement speed and slow resistance.

name: Light 'em Up!
description: Every fourth basic attack launches firecrackers that deal bonus magic damage.

name: Mountain Soul
description: Grants the Mountain Dragon Soul, gaining a shield while out of combat. (Or a different Soul if already owned)

name: Mighty Shield
description: Gaining a shield grants you adaptive force for a short duration. (Has a cooldown)

name: Mind to Matter
description: Grants bonus health equal to half of your maximum mana.

name: Ocean Soul
description: Grants the Ocean Dragon Soul, gaining strong health and mana regeneration after dealing damage. (Or a different Soul if already owned)

name: Poltergeist
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Poltergeist, which grants a spell shield and ghosting at once.

name: ReEnergize
description: Energized attacks on a new target don’t consume stacks. When fully Energized, your next attack deals bonus magic damage based on the target’s current health.

name: Repulsor
description: When your health drops low, knock back and slow nearby enemies. (Has a cooldown, resets on death)

name: Scoped Weapons
description: Increases your attack range. (Reduced for ranged champions)

name: Self Destruct
description: Periodically attaches a bomb to you that detonates, dealing true damage based on enemies’ max health and knocking them up.

name: Shadow Runner
description: After dashing, blinking, or leaving stealth, gain bonus movement speed for a short duration.

name: Sonic Boom
description: Granting a buff, heal, or shield to an ally deals true damage to and slows enemies near that ally.

name: Spin To Win
description: Your spinning abilities deal increased damage and have reduced cooldowns.

name: Swift and Safe
description: After dashing or blinking, gain a shield for a short duration. (Has a cooldown)

name: Tank It Or Leave It
description: When hit, you have a chance based on your crit chance to reduce the damage taken. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: The Brutalizer
description: Grants bonus attack damage, ability haste, and lethality.

name: Tormentor
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy applies an infinitely stacking burn that deals damage over time.

name: Transmute: Gold
description: Gain one random Gold-tier augment.

name: Typhoon
description: Basic attacks also fire at a nearby enemy, dealing reduced damage and applying on-hit effects.

name: Ultimate Unstoppable
description: Casting your ultimate grants crowd-control immunity for a short duration. (Has a cooldown)

name: Upgrade Collector
description: Upgrades The Collector: kills raise its execute threshold and grant extra gold. Also gain 250 gold.

name: Upgrade Immolate
description: Upgrades Immolate items: gain extra gold for each enemy burned by Immolate. Also gain 250 gold.

name: Upgrade Zhonya's
description: Upgrades Zhonya’s Hourglass: move during Stasis with bonus movement speed and a reduced cooldown. Also gain 250 gold.

name: Veil of Warding
description: Grants a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability. (Has a cooldown)

name: Wind Beneath Blade
description: Gain bonus movement speed scaling with your lethality and magic penetration.

name: Witchful Thinking
description: Grants ability power.

name: EscAPADe
description: Converts all of your ability power into bonus attack damage, and additionally increases your total attack damage.

name: All For You
description: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness.

name: Apex Inventor
description: Gain large item haste, reducing the cooldowns of all your item abilities.

name: Big Brain
description: Gain a shield scaling with ability power, replenished on respawn and periodically.

name: Bread And Butter
description: Your first basic ability (Q) gains large ability haste.

name: Bread And Cheese
description: Your third basic ability (E) gains large ability haste.

name: Bread And Jam
description: Your second basic ability (W) gains large ability haste.

name: Celestial Body
description: Gain a large amount of bonus health, but your damage output is reduced.

name: Cheating
description: Upgrades your Recall to Empowered Recall, enabling the shop on completion; your spawn also restores health and resources.

name: Critical Healing
description: Your heals and shields can critically strike for increased effectiveness. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: Critical Rhythm
description: Critical strikes grant stacking bonus attack speed. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
description: When your health drops low, heal a portion of your max health over a few seconds. (Has a cooldown, resets on death)

name: Demon's Dance
description: Gain both the Fleet Footwork and Grasp of the Undying keystone runes.

name: Divine Intervention

name: Ethereal Weapon

name: Executioner
description: Deal increased damage to low-health enemies. Champion takedowns reset all your basic abilities.

name: Firebrand
description: Basic attacks apply an infinitely stacking burn that deals damage over time.

name: Flash 2
description: Replaces a summoner spell with a second Flash and grants summoner spell haste.

name: Flashy
description: Your Flash gains multiple charges with a short cooldown between casts.

name: From Beginning to End
description: Gain both the First Strike and Dark Harvest keystone runes.

name: Get Excited
description: Champion takedowns grant a burst of bonus movement and attack speed.

name: Holy Fire
description: Your heals and shields burn nearby enemies, dealing magic damage over time based on their max health.

name: Impassable
description: Gain both the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes.

name: It's Critical
description: Grants a large amount of critical strike chance.

name: It's Killing Time
description: Casting your ultimate marks all enemies; stored damage detonates as true damage when the mark expires. (Has a cooldown)

name: Keystone Conjurer
description: Gain both the Summon Aery and Arcane Comet keystone runes.

name: Lightning Strikes
description: Increases bonus attack speed from all sources; above a threshold, your basic attacks deal bonus magic damage.

name: Magic Missile
description: Damaging an enemy with an ability fires 3 missiles dealing true damage based on the target’s max health. (Has a cooldown)

name: Marksmage
description: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage scaling with your ability power.

name: Minionmancer
description: Your pets gain increased damage, health, and size.

name: Nightstalking
description: Securing a takedown shortly after damaging an enemy turns you invisible briefly; attacking or casting ends it.

name: OK Boomerang
description: Periodically throw a boomerang at a nearby enemy, dealing adaptive damage.

name: Outlaw's Grit
description: Dashing or blinking grants bonus armor and magic resistance, stacking several times.

name: Overflow
description: Doubles ability mana costs, but increases ability damage, healing, and shielding based on your max mana.

name: Perseverance
description: Greatly increases health regeneration, boosted further while low on health.

name: Rabble Rousing
description: Casting an ability heals you.

name: Recursion
description: Grants ability haste.

name: Restless Restoration
description: Continuously heal while moving.

name: Scopier Weapons
description: Greatly increases your attack range. (Reduced for ranged champions)

name: Searing Dawn
description: Your abilities mark enemies, who take bonus magic damage from your ally’s next attack or ability.

name: Shrink Ray
description: Basic attacks reduce the target’s damage and size for a short duration, refreshing on each hit.

name: Skilled Sniper
description: Hitting a distant enemy with a non-ultimate ability greatly reduces that ability’s cooldown.

name: Slow and Steady
description: Your attack speed is capped, but all bonus attack speed is converted into bonus attack damage.

name: Snowball Upgrade
description: Empowers Mark with haste; on hit it summons a snowstorm dealing area damage and slowing enemies. (Grants Mark if unequipped)

name: Soul Siphon
description: Heal for a portion of your critical strike damage. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: Spiritual Purification
description: Champion takedowns trigger an explosion dealing adaptive damage based on enemies’ current health and leaving a slow zone.

name: Tank Engine
description: Each champion takedown increases your size and max health, stacking infinitely. Lose some stacks on death.

name: Thread the Needle
description: Grants armor penetration and magic penetration.

name: Transmute: Prismatic
description: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment.

name: Twice Thrice
description: Every third basic attack applies on-hit effects an additional time at increased effectiveness.

name: Upgrade Hubris
description: Upgrades Hubris: takedowns heal you and grant movement speed scaling with Eminence stacks. Also gain 250 gold.

name: Upgrade Infinity Edge

name: Upgrade Sheen
description: Upgrades Spellblade items: Spellblade deals bonus damage based on the target’s max health and heals you. Also gain 250 gold.

name: Vampirism
description: You can no longer be healed by allies or regenerate health, but gain strong omnivamp.

name: Vulnerability
description: Damage from items and damage-over-time effects can critically strike. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: With Haste
description: Grants bonus movement speed based on your ability haste.

name: I'm a Baby Kitty Where is Mama
description: Bind to the nearest ally as your "mama"; gain bonus movement speed and heal/shield power while near or moving toward them.

name: Back to Basics
description: Gain increased ability damage, healing, shielding, and ability haste, but your ultimate is permanently locked.

name: Biggest Snowball Ever
description: Mark becomes a giant snowball that pierces minions and explodes on hit, dealing area damage, knock-up, and a slow. (Grants Mark if unequipped)

name: Blade Waltz
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Blade Waltz: dash between enemies, striking repeatedly while untargetable.

name: Can't Touch This
description: Casting your ultimate grants invulnerability for a short duration. (Has a cooldown)

name: Circle of Death
description: Whenever you heal or regenerate, deal a portion of that amount as magic damage to the nearest enemy champion.

name: Clown College
description: Gain Shaco’s Backstab, Deceive, and a death explosion: blink and stealth via Deceive with an empowered next attack, and explode on death to deal true damage and fear enemies.

name: Courage of the Colossus
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy grants a shield that can stack from multiple triggers. (Has a cooldown)

name: Cruelty
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy summons a comet that falls, dealing magic damage in the area.

name: Dashing
description: Abilities with a dash or blink gain large ability haste.

name: Draw Your Sword
description: Become melee; gain attack damage, health, attack speed, life steal, and movement speed scaling with attack range lost. (Ranged only)

name: Dual Wield
description: Basic attacks fire an extra bolt dealing reduced damage and on-hit effects. Also increases your total attack speed.

name: Empyrean Promise
description: Gain heal/shield power and the Vigilance spell: dash to an ally and shield both of you on arrival.

name: Eureka
description: Grants ability haste scaling with your ability power.

name: Fan the Hammer
description: Basic attacks fire a volley of bullets, each dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

name: Feel the Burn
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Feel the Burn: cast Ignite and Exhaust on all nearby enemy champions at once.

name: Fey Magic
description: Damaging enemies with your ultimate polymorphs them into harmless critters briefly. (Per-target cooldown)

name: Final Form
description: Casting your ultimate grants a shield, omnivamp, and bonus movement speed for a short duration. (Has a cooldown)

name: Gash
description: Basic attacks deal bonus true damage scaling with your armor. Also grants bonus attack speed.

name: Giant Slayer
description: Shrink in size for bonus movement speed and deal increased damage to enemies larger than you.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Your max health is greatly reduced, but you deal bonus true damage based on all damage you deal.

name: Goldrend
description: Damaging an enemy champion deals bonus magic damage and grants gold and brief movement speed. (Per-champion cooldown)

name: Goliath
description: Increase your size and gain bonus health and adaptive force.

name: Infernal Conduit
description: Ability hits apply an infinitely stacking burn dealing magic damage over time; each burn tick reduces your basic-ability cooldowns.

name: Jeweled Gauntlet
description: Your abilities can critically strike. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: King Me
description: On first entering the enemy spawn area, become Kinged: gain a random Prismatic augment and upgrade one Legendary item.

name: Laser Heal
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Laser Heal: fire a beam that heals allies and damages and slows enemies.

name: Mad Scientist
description: On acquiring and on each respawn, randomly grow for adaptive force and health, or shrink for ability haste and movement speed.

name: Master of Duality
description: Basic attacks grant ability power and abilities grant attack damage, stacking infinitely and decaying over time.

name: Mystic Punch
description: Basic attacks reduce your abilities’ remaining cooldowns.

name: Ominous Pact
description: Your abilities cost current health, but you gain ability power, movement speed, and omnivamp scaling with missing health.

name: Omni Soul
description: Grants several random Dragon Souls at once.

name: Protein Shake
description: Gain heal and shield power scaling with your bonus armor and magic resistance.

name: Quantum Computing
description: Periodically auto-cast a sweeping slash for physical damage; outer-edge hits deal extra damage, slow enemies, and heal you.

name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
description: Quest: accumulate enough bonus health from Heartsteel. Reward: greatly increase the bonus health it grants.

name: Quest: Urf's Champion
description: Quest: score enough champion takedowns. Reward: receive The Golden Spatula.

name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
description: Now: gain a Needlessly Large Rod. Quest: obtain Rabadon’s Deathcap and Zhonya’s Hourglass. Reward: combine them into Wooglet’s Witchcap.

name: Scopiest Weapons
description: Massively increases your attack range. (Reduced for ranged champions)

name: Slow Cooker
description: Surround yourself in flames, applying an infinitely stacking burn each second that deals magic damage based on your max health.

name: Snowball Roulette
description: Empowers Mark with haste; on hit it casts a random harmful summoner spell on the enemy and a beneficial one on you. (Grants Mark if unequipped)

name: Symphony of War
description: Gain both the Lethal Tempo and Conqueror keystone runes.

name: Tap Dancer
description: Basic attacks grant stacking bonus movement speed, and you gain attack speed scaling with your movement speed.

name: Transmute: Chaos
description: Gain two completely random augments.

name: Ultimate Awakening
description: Gain ultimate haste; casting your ultimate resets all basic abilities and grants large basic-ability haste briefly. (Has a cooldown)

name: Ultimate Revolution
description: Casting your ultimate resets its own cooldown once its effect begins. (Has a cooldown, resets on death)

name: Upgrade Mikael's Blessing
description: Grants and upgrades Mikael’s Blessing: reduced cooldown, and its active cleanses CC, heals, and grants tenacity to nearby allies.

name: Windspeaker's Blessing
description: Your heals and shields grant the target bonus armor and magic resistance for a short duration.

name: Cerberus
description: Gain both the Hail of Blades and Press the Attack keystone runes.

name: Earthwake
description: Dashing or blinking leaves a trail that detonates for physical damage to nearby enemies. (Has a cooldown)

name: Pandora's Box
description: Transform all of your current augments into an equal number of random Prismatic ones.

name: Trueshot Prodigy
description: Damaging a distant enemy fires a Trueshot Barrage that deals magic damage to all enemies it passes through. (Has a cooldown)

name: Slap Around
description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy grants infinitely stacking adaptive force for the round.
Enemy Missing pings launch a missile to the pinged location, exploding to deal magic damage to enemies and heal nearby allies.

name: Hextech Soul
description: Grants the Hextech Dragon Soul, dealing bonus damage when you attack enemies. (Or a different Soul if already owned)

name: Infinite Recursion
description: Grants ability haste, increased further with each champion takedown.

name: Bounce of the Poro King
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Bounce of the Poro King: become the Poro King, bouncing to damage and knock back nearby enemies.

name: Crack Open That Egg
description: When your shield expires, it explodes, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies based on the shield’s strength.

name: Crit 'n Cast
description: Grants ability haste based on your critical strike chance.

name: Critical Missile
description: Critical strikes launch firecrackers for bonus magic damage. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: Devil on Your Shoulder
description: Pact with a little devil: lose health over time, but deal bonus true damage and drop collectible Life Remnants that heal you.

name: Donation
description: Instantly gain a large amount of gold on acquiring this augment.

name: Double Tap
description: Critically striking basic attacks apply on-hit effects an additional time. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: Dropkick
description: Attacks and abilities execute low-health enemies, sending the corpse flying to explode for magic damage; executions heal you.

name: Droppybara
description: Replaces a summoner spell with an orbital laser that deals true damage based on max health plus magic damage over a few seconds.

name: Empowered By The Faithful
description: Healing/shielding an ally blesses them; when they damage enemies you gain Devotion, releasing a shockwave at max that damages and executes low-health enemies.

name: Final City Transit
description: On death, launch a train at your killer that deals physical damage to all enemies it passes through.

name: Firefox
description: Periodically gain bonus movement speed and conjure 3 orbiting flames that fly at nearby enemies, dealing adaptive damage.

name: Grandma's Chili Oil
description: Attacks and abilities burn enemies and spawn a Chili Oil pool that heals allies and burns enemies, scaling with your burn sources.

name: Growth Spurt
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Growth Spurt: rapidly grow, knocking up nearby enemies and gaining max health.

name: Heads Up Cupcake!
description: Cupcakes periodically fly across the map; collecting one grants gold and heals the champion and nearby allies.

name: Holy Snowball

name: Triggered Inferno

name: Juiced
description: Basic attacks consume mana to deal bonus magic damage, which can critically strike.

name: Kill Secured

name: Phenomenal Evil
description: Permanently gain ability power each time you damage an enemy with an ability; start with bonus stacks if picked later.

name: Pinball

name: Poro Blaster

name: Prom Queen

name: Purist - Caster
description: Converts all bonus attack speed into ability haste, and reduces your abilities’ cooldowns by a percentage.

name: Quest: Icathia's Fall
description: Now: gain Bami’s Cinder. Quest: obtain Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance. Reward: combine them into Void Immolation.

name: Red Envelopes
description: Red envelopes periodically appear nearby; collecting one grants gold, brief movement speed, and a random small stat.

name: Shrink Engine
description: Each champion takedown shrinks you and grants ability haste and movement speed, stacking infinitely. Lose some on death.

name: Sonata
description: Alternately auto-cast Aria of Perseverance (heal + shield aura) and Song of Celerity (movement speed aura).

name: Soul Eater
description: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants infinitely stacking max health.

name: Speed Demon
description: Damaging an enemy champion with an ability grants a burst of movement speed that decays.

name: Spin Me Right Round
description: Replaces a summoner spell with Heroic Swing: fire a hook into terrain, then swing around it while auto-firing at nearby enemies.

name: Stats!
description: Gain 2 Stat Bonus Anvils.

name: Stats on Stats!
description: Gain 3 Stat Bonus Anvils, with a higher chance for Gold and Prismatic anvils.

name: Stats on Stats on Stats!
description: Gain 4 Stat Bonus Anvils (higher chance for Gold/Prismatic) and an extra reroll per slot next selection.

name: Stuck in Here With Me

name: Twin Fire
description: Damaging abilities launch firecrackers for bonus magic damage. Also grants critical strike chance.

name: Upgrade Thornmail

name: Void Rift

name: Weighted Popoffs

name: Zealot

name: Hand of Baron
description: Gain adaptive force and greatly empower nearby allied minions.

name: Upgrade Sword of Blossoming Dawn
